name: PRVMTH01.jcl
description:
This JCL job (PRVMTH01) performs month-end provider processing by executing three steps: generating a provider revalidation queue, extracting provider data for T-MSIS (Transformed Medicaid Statistical Information System) reporting, and archiving the T-MSIS output to tape for long-term retention.Key Functionalities:
Reads the Provider Master KSDS file to identify providers requiring revalidation and writes the results to a new date-stamped Revalidation Queue file (80-byte fixed-block records, 5 cylinders primary space).
Reads the Provider Master KSDS file again to extract provider information for T-MSIS state reporting and writes the output to a new date-stamped T-MSIS Provider file (120-byte fixed-block records, 20 cylinders primary space).
Copies the T-MSIS Provider output file to the next generation of a tape-based GDG archive dataset (MMPRV.TMSIS.ARCHIVE +1) for long-term storage using standard tape labeling.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The month-end provider processing job (PRVMTH01) is initiated AND the Provider Master File (MMPRV.PROVIDER.MASTER.KSDS) is available for shared read access AND a new date-stamped Re-evaluation Queue file (MMPRV.REVAL.QUEUE.D&DATE) is allocated to receive output records
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The Provider Re-evaluation program (PRVREV01) is executed and processes all provider records from the Provider Master File to identify providers requiring re-evaluation
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: All providers identified as requiring re-evaluation are written to the date-stamped Re-evaluation Queue file (MMPRV.REVAL.QUEUE.D&DATE) AND if the program completes successfully the Re-evaluation Queue file is cataloged and retained for downstream re-validation processing AND if the program fails the Re-evaluation Queue file is automatically deleted to prevent retention of incomplete or corrupt data

rules.Rule_Name: STEP010 - PRVREV01 - Provider Re-evaluation Queue Generation
rules.Rule_Description: During month-end processing, the Provider Re-evaluation program (PRVREV01) reads the Provider Master File and identifies all providers that require re-evaluation. The qualifying providers are written to a new date-stamped Re-evaluation Queue file, which serves as the work queue driving the provider re-validation workflow for the current month-end cycle. The output file is retained only if the process completes successfully; otherwise, it is automatically removed.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The Provider Master File (MMPRV.PROVIDER.MASTER.KSDS) is available and accessible during the month-end provider processing cycle, and a new date-stamped TMSIS Provider Extract file (MMPRV.TMSIS.PROVIDER.D&DATE) is ready to be created for the current processing date
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The month-end provider processing job (PRVMTH01) triggers STEP020 to execute program PRVTMS01, which reads all provider records from the Provider Master File and transforms them into the TMSIS federal Medicaid reporting format
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: A new date-stamped TMSIS Provider Extract file (MMPRV.TMSIS.PROVIDER.D&DATE) is generated containing all provider records formatted for federal TMSIS Medicaid reporting submission. If the extraction completes successfully, the file is cataloged and retained for downstream archival and federal reporting use. If the extraction fails for any reason, the output file is automatically deleted to ensure no incomplete or corrupt provider data is available for federal submission.

rules.Rule_Name: STEP020 - PRVTMS01 - TMSIS Provider Data Extract for Federal Medicaid Reporting
rules.Rule_Description: During month-end provider processing, program PRVTMS01 reads the Provider Master File and generates a date-stamped TMSIS-formatted provider extract file required for federal Medicaid compliance reporting. The output file is retained only if the extraction completes successfully; otherwise, it is automatically removed to prevent incomplete data from being used in federal submissions.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The TMSIS Provider Extract file (MMPRV.TMSIS.PROVIDER) for the current processing date exists and is available for reading
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The month-end TMSIS Provider archival step is executed
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: 1. The entire contents of the current date's TMSIS Provider Extract file must be copied exactly as-is to the TMSIS Provider Archive tape, with no modifications, transformations, or filtering applied to any record. AND 2. The archive copy must be written as a new incremental generation (+1) of the TMSIS Provider Archive (MMPRV.TMSIS.ARCHIVE), preserving all previously archived generations intact for historical audit and reporting reference. AND 3. The archive file must be written to tape storage as the first file on the tape with a standard tape label. AND 4. If the archival copy completes successfully, the new archive generation must be cataloged and permanently retained in the system. AND 5. If the archival copy fails for any reason, the incomplete archive generation must be automatically deleted to prevent retention of a partial or corrupt archive record.

rules.Rule_Name: STEP030 - IEBGENER - Archive TMSIS Provider Extract to Tape
rules.Rule_Description: At month-end, the TMSIS Provider Extract file generated for the current processing date must be archived to a versioned tape archive as an exact, unmodified copy. A new archive generation is created on every execution to preserve the full history of TMSIS federal Medicaid provider reporting extracts.
